name: cust_phoneidx
parts: PHONE_PERM (U32, one per customer row or empty): the customer rows ordered by SUBSTRING(c_phone, 1, 2) (stable: ascending row within a code)
PHONE_RUNS (U64, m + 1 run starts from 0 to n, or empty): every run of PHONE_PERM holds rows of one country code

layout.summary: custpart unchanged (50 inherited parts), then a U32 permutation of the customer rows grouped by country code (first two characters of c_phone; rows ascending within a code) and the U64 starts of its runs
layout.units: permutation entries are stored (= canonical) customer row positions of custpart; run starts are positions in the permutation
